base: Create a WIDE LANDSCAPE comparison sheet with EXACTLY THREE equally sized portrait panels in ONE horizontal row, full-body SAME Keeper standing in the SAME neutral pose and SAME scale in each panel. Three consecutive images of ONE continuous red takeover process: EARLY, MIDDLE, LATE. Use reference character exactly: copper hair, crown-banded green tall hat with ivory feather/red diamond card, ivory star masquerade mask with black void eyes, green tailcoat, yellow lapels, red waistcoat, white ruffles/gloves, navy trousers/boots, gold ornament. Do not change clothing construction, face, pose or silhouette between panels. Base painting style is the reference detailed dreamy illustration; neutral desaturated gray backdrop in each panel so the RED is extremely legible. Entire hat/feather/boots within EACH frame, generous margins. CRITICAL CORRECTION: supernatural saturated flat SCARLET RED is born at ONLY ONE SINGLE ORIGIN and expands as ONE CONNECTED CONTIGUOUS REGION from it. No multiple origins, no scattered spots, no separate islands, no independent red veins suddenly appearing elsewhere, NO overall tint/color wash. Original colors remain EXACTLY normal outside the advancing red area. Inside consumed area ALL pixels become same solid red, obliterating details/embroidery, including face/clothing when reached. Existing ordinary red vest/ribbon should remain original richly shaded fabric outside corruption; invading red is clearly flat emissive scarlet. Left panel 8-12% consumed; center panel 40-50% consumed; right panel 90-95% consumed, continuous area grows without moving origin. Thin dividing lines; small panel labels ONLY '1', '2', '3' at bottom. No other text or watermark. The three-panel sheet is SET

Late: red has swallowed the body outward from torso, reaching face/hat/arms/coat tails and legs; only small ORIGINAL-COLORED tips at one feather edge and boot toe remain attached at frontier. Shape like liquid filling a paper cutout from one central drop. Clear progression, red coverage monotonically expands.

B. ORIGIN AT THE MASK STAR AT VIEWER-RIGHT TEMPLE. A single red patch begins on that star and leaks down the same side of the face. The border resembles a slowly spreading solid-color film erasing the original painting. Early: only the mask star and adjacent small face patch consumed. Middle: ONE CONNECTED red region has spread across head/hat downward through neck into upper chest and one shoulder; lower torso/legs and distant hand remain original. Late: the same contiguous region flows downward through body and coat, nearly consuming everything except connected original-color frontier near one boot and lowest coat hem. No blood or gore, it's paint-like image corruption. Crisp organic border, not digital stripes.

C. ORIGIN AT VIEWER-LEFT WHITE GLOVED HAND (character's right hand). One solid red patch starts at glove fingertips and climbs that single arm, into shoulder, then chest and the rest of body as one contiguous tide. Early: only that glove and tiny wrist edge red. Middle: glove + forearm + upper arm + shoulder + that half of chest connected in one red region; opposite arm, lower body and most head still normal. Late: one connected red tide has engulfed head, torso, opposite arm and almost all legs/tails, leaving only a small original-color frontier at opposite boot. Advancing border is a sharp gently uneven diagonal wave, like original pixels being eaten away from one hand. Absolutely no floating red shards or separate disconnected patches.
